newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Nordbanken '96 profit 24 pct up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Nordbanken '96 profit 24 pct up.

text.p: Swedish bank Nordbanken is expected on Tuesday to post a higher profit, after credit losses, of 7.29 billion crowns for the full year 1996, according to a Reuters poll of 14 analysts.
The forecasts range from 6.92 billion crowns to 7.61 billion crowns.
During the first nine months of the year the bank posted a profit of 5.74 billion crowns.
In 1995, the bank posted an operating profit of 5.90 billion crowns after credit losses of 1.27 billion crowns.
For 1996, credit losses were on average expected to land at 750 million crowns, making analysts expect a profit before credit losses of 8.05 billion crowns.
On average, analysts expect a dividend of nine crowns a share.
Both in 1997 and 1998, the bank is expected to post a profit after credit losses of 6.4 billion crowns.
